approval_ref: Reference Trunk Tools-style services and let users ask questions answered from existing project files.
notes: Reuse the existing workflow index and exact Email evidence instead of adding another retrieval service.
Distinguish primary Email context from explicit RFI/Submittal references.
Require exact current header/body citations for every published association.
Fail closed on ambiguous Email selection, quoted-history-only links and bounded source ceilings.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Answer exact Email workflow relationship questions locally
objective: Return exact Email-to-RFI/Submittal relationships from existing local evidence without model cost.
